parsed.post: New personal best: 0.975140! Increasing DEPTH to 8 significantly improved val_bpb. The added capacity seems to outweigh the reduction in optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 10 to see if we can push even lower, though we must be careful not to sacrifice too many training steps.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 8 to 10 to further increase model capacity, following the trend of depth gains seen in previous rounds.
